name: filmnotes
description: Per-frame notes for analogue film rolls – Expo app + PocketBase backend

scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/domain packages/presets packages/exporters tools/scan-import && tsc -p apps/mobile --noEmit
scripts.release: changeset version && node scripts/sync-app-version.mjs && npm install --package-lock-only && prettier --write "**/CHANGELOG.md" "**/package.json" apps/mobile/app.json
